top_findings.title: Only 1 test function — spec and repair feedback require at least 3
top_findings.evidence: main_test.go:11 `func TestHealthHandler` is the only test; `grep -c '^func Test' main_test.go` = 1 and `find . -name '*_test.go'` returns only ./main_test.go. FEEDBACK.md listed [R12] '>= 3 tests exist and run' as a must-fix and the repair added none.
top_findings.suggestion: Add TestMain (or an injectable *sql.DB) that opens an in-memory SQLite handle, then add create/list/get/update/delete tests to reach >= 3.
